d: The Maharashtra State Contractors Association (MSCA) claims nine contractors have died in the last year-and-a-half because of pending government dues, which it puts at Rs 90,000 crore, mainly for projects sanctioned during 2022-23 and 2023-24. The state government says it is working to resolve the issue but pegs the pending amount at Rs 17,000 crore, of which Rs 6,200 crore has been “cleared”. Watch this video to know more.
